goal: A /feature gate run reports what is actually true: the promised-tests row stops under-reporting on quoted titles, an armed worktree's step ladder matches its own intake, and a docs-only change still runs every suite that reads a doc.
non_goals: Changing what the verify gate checks, beyond the three defects named here.
Adding a retry or a rerun to any flaky check.
Reworking the red-team sidecar, the review wave, or the gate loop budget.
Extending ci:feature-surface, ci:merge-ledger, or any other ci:* audit script.
Backfilling the 40 existing single-quoted test titles that escape an apostrophe.
Un-skipping ci.yml's test job on docs-only pull requests.
user_visible_behavior: verify-gate.sh's promised-tests row finds a tests_to_add title whose source spelling escapes a quote, so the row goes red only when a test is genuinely absent.
feature-setup.sh carries the parent checkout's ladder only when its axes match the locked intake and it is no older than that intake; otherwise it keeps the intake stub and prints the reason.
arm-check.sh's ladder message no longer claims a carry outcome it does not decide.
arm-check.sh refuses to arm, naming the field, when the intake's size, risk, or surface is absent or not one of the declared values, instead of silently defaulting to standard/normal/backend.
ci.yml's lint job runs the doc-reading guard suites, so a docs-only pull request that busts a documentation shape cap fails.
verify-gate.sh's docs-only mode runs the same doc-reading suites as the lint job.
A new src test that reads a doc at run time fails the wiring guard until it is added to both docs-only lanes.
invariants: The promised-tests row can still only fail when a promised title is absent from every searched root; normalization never makes an absent title match.
A gate row name stays one status slot, one log file, and one coverage directory (#696).
lefthook.yml continues to mirror every ci:* audit the lint job runs, as src/__tests__/ci-audit-wiring.test.ts enforces (#590).
The docs-only short-circuit stays intact: a docs diff still skips the full test job, the build, promised-tests, reclassify, and diff-coverage.
.feature/intake.json stays the authoritative record of a run's axes; the ladder never overrides it.
The intake stays gitignored at .feature/ and committed only as the docs/superpowers/plans audit copy (#512).
edge_cases: A promised title containing both an apostrophe and a quotation mark: the matcher tries the verbatim spelling and each single-character escape spelling, so either source quoting style matches.
A promised title containing a literal backslash: the verbatim spelling still matches, because normalization adds candidate spellings and never rewrites the searched files.
A promised title that is genuinely absent: every candidate spelling misses, and the row reports it missing, as today.
Steps 0 and 1 legitimately run on main while the worktree is on the feature branch, so the carry decision must not compare branches.
No parent ladder exists at all: arm-check's stub stands and feature-setup prints nothing about a carry.
The parent ladder exists but predates the locked intake (a merged earlier run): the carry is refused and the stub stands.
The parent ladder's axes match the intake and its timestamp is newer: the carry proceeds exactly as today.
An intake whose risk is an object rather than a string: arm-check fails loudly naming the field instead of reading normal.
A docs-only change that touches no doc a guard suite reads: the doc-reading suites run anyway and pass; they are fast file reads.
A future fourth doc-reading suite: the wiring guard fails until it appears in ci.yml's lint job and in verify-gate.sh.
existing_patterns_to_follow: scripts/gate-rows.sh — the sourceable-helper seam for bash logic the gate needs and a test must exercise without running the gate; its header states the rationale.
scripts/ci/__tests__/gate-rows.test.ts — sources the helper under the gate's own shell flags and calls its functions directly.
scripts/ci/__tests__/feature-workflow-runtime.test.ts — drives progress.mjs and the arming scripts as CLIs against a fixture repo.
src/__tests__/ci-audit-wiring.test.ts — a guard test, not another ci:* script, because an audit that checks wiring would have to be wired itself.
scripts/ci/__tests__/red-team-status.test.ts:28 — the file-level vi.setConfig timeout precedent for process-spawning suites.
.claude/rules/ci-tooling.md — a test that spawns git in a throwaway repo passes env: GIT_FREE_ENV.
test_seams: scripts/gate-promised-tests.sh — promised_title_spellings and promised_title_found, sourced directly by a vitest suite.
node .agents/skills/feature/scripts/progress.mjs carry — invoked as a CLI against a fixture parent and worktree.
bash scripts/arm-check.sh — invoked as a CLI against a fixture worktree with a crafted .feature/intake.json.
The parsed text of .github/workflows/ci.yml, lefthook.yml and scripts/verify-gate.sh, read by the wiring guard.

rollback_plan: Revert the pull request. Every change is developer tooling: no migration runs, no deployed surface changes, and no runtime code path moves. A revert restores the previous gate behavior on the next gate run with no cleanup.
observability: The verify gate's own PASS/FAIL table names the promised-tests and doc-shape rows on every run.
feature-setup.sh prints the carry outcome and its reason at arming time.
The lint job's doc-reading step appears in every pull request's check output, including docs-only ones.
